newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian PM vows war if prince returns.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian PM vows war if prince returns.

text.p: Cambodian Co-Premier Hun Sen on Sunday threatened to shoot down any airliner that brought exiled Prince Norodom Sirivudh back to Phnom Penh.

"Any plane which dares to carry Sirivudh will be hit. Please tell the world that Hun Sen does not threaten but tells the truth and will dare to do it," Hun Sen said in a speech to flood victims northeast of the capital.
He said tanks and heavy weapons were ready for action in Phnom Penh. "The real battlefield will be Pochentong (airport)."
Sirivudh, the half-brother of King Norodom Sihanouk, was arrested in November 1995 for allegedly plotting to assassinate Hun Sen.
A month later he agreed to go into exile in France rather than face trial, but was sentenced in absentia in a trial which international observers branded a travesty.
Sirivudh has said he is determined to return to Cambodia but has not said exactly when.

Tension is simmering in Cambodia's northwest between military foreces loyal to Hus Sen's ex-communist Cambodian People's Party and those supporting its coalition government partner, the FUNCINPEC group, of which Sirivudh is a member.
